title: AttributeResult judgement for 'covertness' (Stage 2, LLM)
description: Visual claims: if `reasoning` describes what a screenshot shows (color, legibility, layout, contrast, etc.), you MUST either (a) include at least one evidence_pointers entry whose signal is prefixed "screenshot_visual_inspection", or (b) set visual_claim_unverified: true. A response with a visual claim and neither is rejected at ingest -- see journey/mechanism_verdict_ingest.py.

ui_region.description: Copy this from the matching pointer's ui_region already shown to you in evidence_summary.json -- never invent one. If you're pointing at something not already tagged there, use "unclassified".

signal.description: Which measurement/observation this points at. If this specific claim rests on something you saw in an attached screenshot (not a measured field in evidence_summary.json), prefix it "screenshot_visual_inspection" -- see response_schema.json's top-level note on visual claims.

visual_claim_unverified.description: Optional. Set true if reasoning makes a visual claim you cannot ground in an image-sourced evidence_pointers entry.
